annotations.title: Get guest reviews for a hotel

description: Fetch a hotel's guest reviews from VICATOO's own reviews: the guest rating (out of 10, with the number of reviews) and the written reviews (pros, cons, comments), from the same source, newest first. Paginate the written reviews with `cursor` and `limit`. When the hotel's reviews have no written comments, the reply says so — do not invent any.

hotel_id.description: VICATOO hotel id — numeric hid, the hotel_id search_hotels returns, or the slug; all are resolved server-side.

name: get_hotel_reviews
title: Get guest reviews for a hotel
